drafted_from: tool row in tools/keep-a-video-packaging-ledger/tool-rows.json, do-work/project_packaging_ledger.py and the fixture of test/test_channel_intake_append_new.py (run to observe)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Make the ch-example-videos rows of my packaging ledger into a source I can build a word-for-word template from, as out/SOURCE.html and out/SPEC.json." It reads the tool's row and runs project_packaging_ledger.py on your computer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no Trillion list: the ledger is a JSON Lines file in the person's own working folder, one row per video, and the tool reads and writes files there.
instructions: 1. Have a packaging ledger with rows under one source key (tool:add-reviewed-videos-to-a-packaging-ledger makes them).

2. Say which source key and where to write the HTML source and the spec. The AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: tool:project-a-packaging-ledger-into-template-source} and runs its `run` command; to refresh only some videos add --previous-html and one --replace-video-id per video.
3. Read the last JSON line: source_key, videos, records, output_html, output_spec.
4. Build the template from the spec with tool:make-a-word-template, then check it with tool:check-a-compiled-packaging-template-against-the-ledger.

worked_examples.title: Project two videos into template source
worked_examples.ask: Make the ch-example-videos rows of my packaging ledger into a source I can build a template from.
worked_examples.given: I ran project_packaging_ledger.py on a ledger holding the two rows the fixture of tools/keep-a-video-packaging-ledger/test/test_channel_intake_append_new.py adds (new-video-1 and new-video-2). Command: python3 -I tools/keep-a-video-packaging-ledger/do-work/project_packaging_ledger.py --root /work/example-channel --ledger /work/example-channel/NEW.jsonl --source-key ch-example-videos --output-html /work/example-channel/out/SOURCE.html --output-spec /work/example-channel/out/SPEC.json.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"source_key": "ch-example-videos", "videos": 2, "records": 16, "output_html": "/work/example-channel/out/SOURCE.html", "output_spec": "/work/example-channel/out/SPEC.json"} SPEC.json has schema word-template-spec@1, piece id youtube-source:ch-example-videos and an html_json_records source pointing at SOURCE.html script id packaging; SOURCE.html holds one inert application/json block of the 16 records, a unit per video (video-new-video-1, video-new-video-2) with caption source references that carry file identity and event range but no caption text.
